wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
FREE SPINS
 3 or more SCATTER symbols trigger the FREE SPINS round.
 The round starts with 6 free spins.
 The FREE SPINS round has a progressive feature.
 When the round starts, a 1x1 WILD symbol is always present on the screen, moving to a
 random position at every free spin.
All the SCATTER symbols that hit in free spins are collected until the end of the round. Every 3rd SCATTER symbol
collected retriggers the feature, awards a random number of free spins from 1 to 3, and the roaming WILD symbol
 increases in size progressively, to 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 and 5x5.
 After the 4th retrigger, the feature cannot be retriggered anymore.
 If the feature was triggered with 5 SCATTER symbols, the round starts with 2 SCATTERS already collected.
 If the feature was triggered with 4 SCATTER symbols, the round starts with 1 SCATTER already collected.
 Special reels are in play during the FREE SPINS round.

features.name: Ante Bet
features.effects:
The player has the option to select the bet multiplier. Depending on the selected bet, the game
 behaves differently. The possible values are:
 Bet multiplier 25x - Normal Play
 Bet multiplier 30x - The chance to win FREE SPINS naturally is doubled. More SCATTER
 symbols are present on the reels.
